heading: Pink bought 200-acre California ranch; 13 years later, it became a vineyard
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: Pink bought a 200-acre California ranch with her husband Carey Hart for nearly $9 million in 2013. What began as an interest in wine grew into Two Wolves, an organic wine business. After years of studying winemaking and making small batches privately, Pink released her first vintage in 2014 and has since built a team around organic farming and winemaking.
